entities.name: Moth's note
entities.dialogueText: THREE STAR SEEDS, THEN OUT BY THE COAL CHUTE IN THE YARD. THE CHUTE IS PAST THE KITCHEN.
dialogueMore: HOLD X TO SNEAK: SLOW AND SILENT. WALKING IS HEARD, GRAVEL ALWAYS CRUNCHES.
C THROWS A PEBBLE. WARDENS GO TO LOOK WHERE IT LANDS. YOU HAVE EIGHT.
GRASS, CURTAINS AND FERNS HIDE YOU. SHADOWS HIDE YOU IF YOU KEEP STILL.
BUMP A WARDEN FROM BEHIND TO KNOCK HIM OUT. IF ONE CATCHES YOU, BACK TO THE LAST LAMP.

entities.name: Barracks notice
entities.dialogueText: BARRACKS. THE PORTCULLIS LIFTS WHEN THE ALARM RINGS.

rules.note: Pulling the fuses cuts the vault camera (Off while channel 3 is on).

entities.name: Fuse label
entities.dialogueText: VAULT CAMERA FUSES. DO NOT TOUCH.

entities.name: Chute sign
entities.dialogueText: COAL CHUTE. ALL THREE SEEDS, AND YOU ARE AWAY.
